review_candidates.description: Meezan Bank is hiring an experienced banking and finance professional for the position of Transaction Manager – Contract Finance at its Head Office in Karachi . The position is part of the Investment Banking & Shariah Advisory function within the Corporate, Commercial & Investment Banking Group . Discover more Job Listings Compensation & Benefits South Asians & Diaspora This is a managerial-level opportunity for professionals with at least five years of relevant experience who have expertise in transaction execution, contract financing, financing structures, credit documentation, compliance, and coordination across banking functions. Job Overview Position: Transaction Manager – Contract Finance Bank: Meezan Bank Function: Investment Banking & Shariah Advisory Group: Corporate, Commercial & Investment Banking Group Location: Head Office, Karachi Experience Required: Minimum 5 years of relevant managerial experience Education: Minimum Bachelor’s degree Preferred Education: Master’s in Business Administration, Accounting or Finance Preferred Professional Qualifications: ACCA, ACA, CFA, ICMA or equivalent Additional Advantage: Qualification in Islamic Finance About The Position The Transaction Manager – Contract Finance will be responsible for managing financing transactions from structuring and documentation through execution, monitoring, and reporting. The position requires a combination of financial analysis, transaction management, credit understanding, contract review, business development, and coordination with multiple internal departments. Because the role sits within Investment Banking & Shariah Advisory, candidates should also be comfortable working within the principles and requirements of Islamic banking. Transaction Execution and Contract Financing A major responsibility will be managing transaction execution and contract financing activities . The Transaction Manager will help take financing opportunities from the initial business stage through structuring, approvals, documentation, and execution. Candidates should understand how financing requirements are evaluated and converted into appropriate facilities while considering the client’s business requirements, transaction risks, documentation, and the bank’s internal policies. Business Development The role also involves business development activities . This means the position is not limited to internal transaction processing. The successful candidate may contribute to identifying financing opportunities, understanding client requirements, developing appropriate solutions, and helping grow the bank’s contract finance business. Strong commercial awareness and the ability to understand corporate clients and their financing requirements will therefore be useful. Structuring Financing Facilities The Transaction Manager will be involved in structuring financing facilities . This requires understanding the underlying transaction, identifying financing requirements, evaluating associated risks, and helping develop a financing structure that can proceed through the bank’s approval process. Experience in corporate banking, investment banking, structured finance, project or contract finance, credit, or related areas can be particularly relevant. Contract Review and Credit Documentation Another important responsibility is reviewing contracts and preparing credit and approval documentation . Candidates should be capable of analyzing commercial agreements and identifying terms that could affect financing arrangements, payment flows, obligations, guarantees, and transaction risks. The role also requires preparing clear documentation for internal review and approval. Strong financial analysis, business writing, and attention to detail are therefore important. Cross-Functional Coordination Transaction execution requires cooperation between several departments. The Transaction Manager Will Coordinate With Teams Including Legal Geographic Reference Operations Credit Administration Shariah Trade Operations The successful candidate will need to ensure that relevant requirements from these functions are addressed before and during transaction execution. This makes stakeholder management and communication skills particularly important. Transaction Monitoring and Compliance The role continues beyond the initial approval of a financing facility. The Transaction Manager will monitor transaction conditions, milestones, guarantees, documentation, compliance requirements, records, and reporting . This can involve ensuring that required conditions have been satisfied, guarantees remain properly documented, transaction milestones are tracked, and appropriate records are maintained throughout the financing lifecycle. Qualification Requirements Candidates must have at least a Bachelor’s degree from an HEC-recognized institution . Meezan Bank states a preference for candidates holding a Master’s degree in Business Administration, Accounting, or Finance . Professional qualifications such as ACCA, ACA, CFA, ICMA, or an equivalent credential will also be preferred. A qualification in Islamic Finance will be considered an additional advantage. Experience Requirements Applicants should have a minimum of five years of relevant managerial experience . Candidates should ensure that their CV clearly demonstrates experience relevant to contract finance and transaction management rather than simply stating their total number of years in banking. Relevant exposure could include transaction execution, corporate financing, credit analysis, financing structures, contract review, guarantees, trade operations, investment banking, or related financing activities. Skills Relevant to the Role A suitable candidate should demonstrate strong capabilities in transaction management, financial and credit analysis, contract financing, facility structuring, business development, documentation, compliance monitoring, and stakeholder coordination. Knowledge of Islamic banking and Shariah-compliant financing structures can further strengthen a candidate’s profile, particularly given the nature of Meezan Bank’s operations. Who Should Consider Applying? This opportunity may be relevant to experienced professionals currently working in areas such as Corporate Banking, Investment Banking, Contract Finance, Structured Finance, Credit, Transaction Banking, Trade Finance, or Shariah-compliant financing . Professionals seeking to move into a role that combines transaction execution with financing structures, client development, documentation, and cross-functional management may find the responsibilities particularly relevant. How to Strengthen Your Application Applicants should tailor their CV around transaction and financing experience. Useful information to highlight includes the size and type of financing transactions managed, financing facilities structured, contracts reviewed, credit proposals prepared, corporate clients handled, guarantees monitored, and experience coordinating with Legal, Credit, Operations, Trade, or Shariah teams. Candidates holding ACCA, ACA, CFA, ICMA, Islamic Finance, or other relevant qualifications should make these credentials clearly visible. http://www.meezanbank.com

Key Responsibilities • Review and analyze all tender documents, including general and particular conditions, technical specifications, drawings, Bill of Quantities (BOQ), addenda, and related documents. • Prepare technical and financial proposals for roads and infrastructure projects. • Perform detailed rate analysis and cost breakdowns for BOQ items, including direct and indirect costs. • Carry out quantity take-off from drawings and verify quantities against the tender BOQ. • Identify project requirements for materials, equipment, manpower, suppliers, and subcontractors. • Obtain, review, and evaluate quotations from suppliers and subcontractors and prepare technical and commercial comparisons. • Prepare the final project estimation and tender pricing in coordination with the concerned departments and management. • Prepare and review technical proposals, construction methodologies, execution plans, and other technical submissions required by the tender. • Ensure that all tender requirements, documents, forms, certificates, and submissions are complete prior to tender submission. • Handle and manage tenders through Saudi government electronic procurement platforms, particularly Etimad Platform, including tender submission, uploading documents, following clarifications, addenda, and tender updates. • Review payment terms, penalties, guarantees, bonds, insurance requirements, project duration, and contractual conditions that may affect the project cost. • Prepare technical and commercial queries and Requests for Clarification (RFCs) related to tender documents. • Maintain and continuously update a database of market rates for materials, equipment, manpower, suppliers, and subcontractors. • Follow up on tender results and conduct post-tender analysis to improve the accuracy and competitiveness of future bids. • Coordinate with Technical, Projects, Procurement, Contracts, and Finance departments during the tendering and estimation process. Qualifications & Experience • Bachelor’s Degree in Civil Engineering. • Minimum 10 years of overall professional experience. • Minimum 5 years of experience specifically in tendering and estimation for roads and infrastructure projects within Saudi Arabia. • Strong practical experience in road works, asphalt works, earthworks, utilities, and infrastructure networks. • Proven experience in preparing comprehensive technical and financial proposals. • Strong experience in rate analysis, BOQ item analysis, cost estimation, and project budgeting. • Strong experience in reviewing drawings, specifications, BOQs, and performing Quantity Take-Off (QTO). • Practical experience in using Eitmad Platform and other Saudi government tendering and procurement platforms. • Good knowledge of Saudi government tendering and procurement procedures. • Strong knowledge of the Saudi construction market, including current rates for materials, equipment, manpower, suppliers, and subcontractors, preferably within the Western Region. • Proficiency in Microsoft Excel, AutoCAD, PDF reviewing tools, and relevant quantity take-off and estimation software. • Good command of the English language, with the ability to review and prepare technical and commercial tender documents. Required Skills • Strong analytical and cost estimation skills. • High level of accuracy and attention to detail. • Strong ability to read and interpret engineering drawings, specifications, and contractual documents. • Ability to work under pressure and meet strict tender submission deadlines. • Strong negotiation and communication skills with suppliers and subcontractors. • Ability to manage and coordinate multiple tenders simultaneously. • Ability to identify technical, commercial, contractual, and cost risks within tender documents prior to submission. • Ability to prepare clear tender evaluation reports and commercial comparisons to support management decisions. Preference will be given to candidates with previous experience working for major contracting companies in Saudi Arabia, particularly in roads and infrastructure projects.

For internal candidates holding an indefinite-term contract, alternative contractual arrangements may apply in accordance with institutional policies. The team consists of 50+ people and there are occasional atypical working hours, in the evening/morning, to accommodate online meetings with headquarters and stakeholders based in Europe. The recruited person will be attributed functions depending on the needs of the Delegation which may evolve over time . The successful candidate will serve under the supervision and responsibility of the Head of Regional Partnerships and a Team Leader, providing analytical, operational and coordination support across a range of regional cooperation priorities, including project and programme management, policy analysis and dialogue, engagement with financial institutions and development partners, communication, and monitoring and evaluation.
